opening.argument: The presentation ties a Ludo game directly to monetary reward and withdrawal. Its title promises, “Play Ludo game and win Paytm cash,” while the description asks viewers to follow instructions for withdrawing money from the game. It also directs viewers to download an app through external links and describes logging in by entering an email ID and password. Those features make the offer a low-barrier route to claimed cash benefits while placing credential entry within the process. The records do not establish that money was paid, credentials were collected, or what the linked destinations do, but they do show a reward-based acquisition pitch coupled with external downloading and login instructions.
